newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur fuel oil unchanged, slow.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur fuel oil unchanged, slow.

text.p: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil prices were little changed on Monday in quiet business, traders said.
High sulphur barges traded at $88 a tonne fob ARA and bids and offers remained bracketed around this number for much of the day.
High sulphur cargoes were thin, too. Offers of straight-run material were seen improving, with E-4 cargoes talked at a premium of around $5 to the mean/mean/mean of published quotes.
Low sulphur fuel oil was scarce, following a spate of buying last week, traders said.
One NWE refiner was heard to be offering one percent sulphur material at $97 a tonne fob NWE but this number was described as rather ambitious by some dealers, who pegged the market at around $95.
"But there is not a lot out there," one dealer said.
